title: VoxelGI tooltip displays incorrect cell size
body: ### Tested versions Godot v4.6.dev4 ### System information Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.7076) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1135G7 @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.80 GiB memory ### Issue description Trying to reduce light leaking of `VoxelGI`. It’s useful to see the actual voxel cell size so you can adjust wall thickness or GI subdiv appropriately. However, the "Bake VoxelGI" button tooltip is misleading - the displayed cell size does not match the real voxel size For size=32 and subdiv=64 the cell size should be at least 32/64=0.5. The tooltip instead shows 0.25, while the VoxelGI Lighting viewport debug mode disagrees and visualizes a larger voxel size ### Steps to reproduce 1. Bake any mesh usnig `VoxelGI` 2. Switch viewport mode to Display Advanced >VoxelGI Lighting 3. Look at the "Bake VoxelGI" button tooltip 4. Create a cube with size equals to the tooltip’s displayed cell size 5. The cube does not match the actual voxel size ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [voxelgi-incorrect-tooltip.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23820807/voxelgi-incorrect-tooltip.zip) 1. Switch viewport mode to Display Advanced >VoxelGI Lighting 2. Compare voxel cell size with a cube
